parameters.voice_description: An original English-speaking mascot voice for Merc, an ageless liquid-metal adventure sprite who reads as a young adult. Feminine-leaning and bright with a clear light register, energetic but controlled, playful quick timing and a mischievous spark. Expressive pitch movement without sing-song exaggeration. Crisp natural articulation for short game dialogue. Dry, close-mic studio recording with excellent audio quality; no music, background sound or reverb. Moderate conversational volume, never shouting. A friendly encouraging coach, never childish, squeaky, screechy, shrill, breathless, announcer-like or imitative.
parameters.text:
A little note can break glass.

Hum a comfortable note.

Beautiful. A new path is open.

Gorgeous. Absolutely gorgeous.

You broke that with your voice. I need to sit down. I don't have legs.
